P1.purpose: Direct pairing crypto / logical DLL removal.
P1.note: Load only what exists and is needed for the current task; absence of a listed implementation file is a routing hint to verify, not permission to invent it.

P2.purpose: Pure CONFIG90 derivation and opaque BB010002 structural boundary.
P2.private_evidence: Ignored development/ evidence is consulted only under the approved P2 protected-evidence gate and is never copied into public artifacts.

P3.purpose: Explicit zero-seed FDT lifecycle with bounded no-finger learning.
P3.note: State-v2 activation selects the explicit absent-zero seed mode, so the first manual 0x36 carries an all-zero reference. The IRQ 0x0100 touch mask is relative to the reference in effect: the first sample accepts any subset of the six channel bits, while the second and third samples still require exact zero because their reference is the table learned from the preceding sample.

P4.purpose: Crash-safe per-reader state-v2 and side-by-side legacy migration.
P4.note: The module is host-only: it contains no USB or pairing writer and reconciliation never recommends a speculative E0.

P6.purpose: Integrated read-only preflight, generated CONFIG90/zero-seed qualification, then journaled single-E0 and recovery proof.
P6.note: The pairing writer has exactly one reviewed production caller: the crash-safe activation orchestration in goodix_pairing_activation. Live-proven on the qualification reader: the read-only preflight, the one-shot pairing transaction (PREPARED reservation, exactly one E0, exact BB010002/BB020003 readbacks, TLS proof, ACTIVE promotion), the ordinary zero-E0 ACTIVE reopen through the REUSE_ACTIVE_TLS disposition, and the zero-seed FDT no-finger bootstrap whose first manual sample legitimately carries a nonzero touch mask. Item 8 is closed on offline evidence by explicit User decision: the crash-window matrix plus the host-shaped superseded-PREPARED recovery test (RECOVER_PREPARED_TLS with zero persistent writes and zero E0) are the accepted evidence, and the residual risk that no live reproduction exists is recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md. The epoch audit exposes monotonic FDT learning, both delta-gate counters, the baseline image counters and the pairing disposition, so a cancelled no-finger action is decidable.

P7.purpose: Windows/Linux coexistence and stable reuse of the same Linux PSK across OS transitions.
P7.note: Closed: WINDOWS_LINUX_PING_PONG=PASS on the operator-executed bounded sequence L1 -> W1 -> L1 -> W2 -> L1 with the same Windows 11 VM and USB passthrough. Windows recovered autonomously twice, each Linux return classified the change read-only as an external replacement and restored the same stored L1 with exactly one qualified write preserving the live Windows BB010002 byte-for-byte, and each same-OS reopen stayed at zero writes and zero E0 through REUSE_ACTIVE_TLS; no new Linux key, no loop and no second writer. Evidence boundary: no Windows fingerprint enrollment or authentication was performed, so Windows biometric functionality is outside the qualified scope. Decisive counters are summarized in docs/VALIDATION.md; the operator holds the full sanitized audit blocks. Load these artifacts only for read-only analysis of the restore/reuse dispositions: no pairing, E0, secure-session or state-v2 write path may change without a new gate.

P8.purpose: Biometric and desktop integration qualification on the self-contained bootstrap.
P8.note: Closed: SELF_CONTAINED_BIOMETRIC_STACK=PASS on the operator-executed bounded live sequence. Qualified on the self-contained bootstrap: canonical KDE enrollment of two fingers, stock VERIFY match and no-match, a real stock IDENTIFY with two enrolled fingers, fingerprint authentication for Plasma Login, KScreenLocker, sudo and PolicyKit, three-attempt bounded failure series with working password fallback, clean cancel and release paths, and clean baseline/FDT behavior with zero pairing writes. Temperature is qualified only as far as the implementation goes: the driver adds no thermal override, so the stock libfprint FpTemperature lifecycle applies unchanged and no forced-HOT transition was tested. Cold login passes with the documented roughly one-second readiness delay. Evidence detail lives in docs/VALIDATION.md; the operator holds the full sanitized audit blocks. Successor phase P9 is operator-managed and deliberately not routed here: AI PM must not start, preflight, schedule or orchestrate it, and these artifacts are loadable for read-only analysis only.
